definitions: Used in questions and negative statements to refer to an indefinite quantity or number of something.
Used with a singular countable noun to refer to one or some of something, when it does not matter which.
Used to emphasize a lack of restriction or limitation.
Used to refer to an unspecified amount or number of something, typically in conditional clauses.
examples: You can choose any book you like.
If you have any questions, please ask.
